description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing input devices within the Android input system, including InputDevice, InputDeviceContext, and related methods for device configuration, state, and interaction with EventHub.

classes.name: InputDevice
classes.description: Represents and manages a single input device, providing methods for configuration, state management, and interaction with input hardware.

classes.name: InputDeviceContext
classes.description: Provides a limited interface to interact with the EventHub for a specific InputDevice, used by input mappers to query device status and properties.

methods.name: InputDevice::isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the input device is currently enabled.

methods.name: InputDevice::setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the input device at a specified time.

methods.name: InputDevice::dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state and configuration of the input device for debugging.

methods.name: InputDevice::addEventHubDevice
methods.description: Adds a new EventHub device entry for the input device.

methods.name: InputDevice::removeEventHubDevice
methods.description: Removes an EventHub device entry.

methods.name: InputDevice::configure
methods.description: Configures the input device with new settings.

methods.name: InputDevice::reset
methods.description: Resets the input device to its default state.

methods.name: InputDevice::process
methods.description: Processes raw input events.

methods.name: InputDevice::timeoutExpired
methods.description: Handles timeout expiration for input device.

methods.name: InputDevice::updateExternalStylusState
methods.description: Updates the stylus state for external stylus devices.

methods.name: InputDevice::getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the input device.

methods.name: InputDevice::getKeyCodeState
methods.description: Returns the state of a specific key code.

methods.name: InputDevice::getScanCodeState
methods.description: Returns the state of a specific scan code.

methods.name: InputDevice::getSwitchState
methods.description: Returns the state of a switch.

methods.name: InputDevice::getKeyCodeForKeyLocation
methods.description: Returns key code for a specific key location.

methods.name: InputDevice::markSupportedKeyCodes
methods.description: Marks supported key codes.

methods.name: InputDevice::vibrate
methods.description: Triggers vibration sequence.

methods.name: InputDevice::cancelVibrate
methods.description: Cancels ongoing vibration.

methods.name: InputDevice::isVibrating
methods.description: Checks if device is vibrating.

methods.name: InputDevice::getVibratorIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of vibrators.

methods.name: InputDevice::enableSensor
methods.description: Enables a sensor with specified parameters.

methods.name: InputDevice::disableSensor
methods.description: Disables a sensor.

methods.name: InputDevice::flushSensor
methods.description: Flushes sensor data.

methods.name: InputDevice::setLightColor
methods.description: Sets the color of a device light.

methods.name: InputDevice::setLightPlayerId
methods.description: Sets the player ID for a device light.

methods.name: InputDevice::getLightColor
methods.description: Gets the color of a device light.

methods.name: InputDevice::getLightPlayerId
methods.description: Gets the player ID of a device light.

methods.name: InputDevice::getMetaState
methods.description: Returns the meta state.

methods.name: InputDevice::updateMetaState
methods.description: Updates the meta state based on key code.

methods.name: InputDevice::addKeyRemapping
methods.description: Adds a key remapping.

methods.name: InputDevice::bumpGeneration
methods.description: Increments the device's generation counter.

methods.name: InputDevice::notifyReset
methods.description: Notifies about device reset.

methods.name: InputDevice::getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns device configuration properties.

methods.name: InputDevice::getEventHub
methods.description: Returns the associated EventHub interface.

methods.name: InputDevice::getAssociatedDisplayId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated display.

methods.name: InputDevice::updateLedState
methods.description: Updates the LED state.

methods.name: InputDevice::getMapperCount
methods.description: Returns the number of mappers associated with the device.

methods.name: InputDevice::addMapper
methods.description: Constructs and adds a mapper to the device.

methods.name: InputDevice::constructAndAddMapper
methods.description: Constructs and adds a mapper to the device.

methods.name: InputDevice::addController
methods.description: Constructs and adds a controller to the device.
